pick.headline: Hugo Chavez leads failed coup in Venezuela
pick.summary: On February 4, 1992, army officers led by Lieutenant Colonel Hugo Chavez attempted to overthrow President Carlos Andres Perez; the coup failed within hours and Chavez surrendered on television.
pick.significance: The attempt revealed the fragility of one of Latin America's oldest democracies and made Chavez a national figure who would be elected president in 1998.
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of February 5, 1992, carried Latin American presidents backing President Perez and Buenos Aires TELAM on the Rio Group condemning the attempted coup in Venezuela, with Bolivia seeking an emergency OAS session.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Latin America, No. 024, 5 February 1992
evidence.snippet: …Andres Rodriguez (Pazaguay), and Luis Alberto Lacalle (Uruguay). Bolivian Foreign Minister Carlos Iturraide has said that Bolivia will request the holding of an emergency OAS session to express institutional support for Venezuelan democracy and to block future events similar the one that occurred in the predawn hours of today in Caracas.
